name: Paola
self_text: I am a non-binary Spanish person in my late 20s who loves fermenting hot sauce. I use a Leica. I am looking for a relaxed photo walk at a fast pace. I am available Sunday afternoons or weekday evenings. We can take portraits of each other and I am happy to teach post-processing. Gear talk is fine but not the point.

requests.request_text: I need you to be the one who learns post-processing from me, and you have to be okay with a moderate pace or a fast pace. Only if you are okay with taking portraits of each other will this work. I'd strongly prefer that you are available Sunday afternoon or weekday evenings, though it's not a requirement. It would be nice if you are into a relaxed photo walk, and a small bonus if you are okay with plenty of gear talk or gear talk is fine but not the point.
